acceptance: Extend existing continuity_resume, validate_project and git_continuity owners; no schema, service, store, database, daemon or new directory.

AUTHORITY_SNAPSHOT captures native resume context in an immutable process-local object. Reuse requires exact root/repository, HEAD/index/worktree candidate fingerprint, relevant authority bytes, scope and named evidence. Serialized objects are presentation only and rejected as executable authority.

Reusable Authority Attestation captures a successful existing validate_governed_mutation_entry outcome. Reuse requires fresh fingerprint before and after, all native input bindings unchanged and a live bound remote read on EVERY executable call. Missing/stale attestation fails closed; explicit fresh verification rebuilds it.

Reference-first evidence returns immutable commit/path/blob locators only for committed unchanged named evidence; mutable copies and a snapshot alone never prove PASS. Unchanged exact inputs may reuse recorded local test evidence; release candidate still gets one full suite.

Native W/P finalization builds a STATE candidate only after live verified W and genuinely independent exact-W POST. It never completes a Work Unit. Separate explicit user closure applies COMPLETE; actual P readback verifies exact metadata paths, W ancestry, preserved generic tree and STATE revision/verified-W binding.

Low-risk correction planning is bounded to already owned docs/evidence metadata, excludes CONTROL/STATE/code/schema/WorkUnit/Instruction/review authority, retains native gate and independent review; candidate changes invalidate reuse.

Real Consumer acceptance uses an independent acceptance branch, no business main writes; measures a fresh controlled before/after sequence, records byte freshness reads separately, never estimates historical counts. At least one actual unchanged reuse and one durable-marker invalidation/fresh rebuild; Stage1/core/conflict checks and durable closure.
goal: Issue17 Stage2 bounded governance authority reuse and real Consumer acceptance
